# SOF EXPO Samarkand

> Exhibition and congress centre in Samarkand, Uzbekistan, operated by LLC «RESOF EXPO».
> One transformable indoor hall of 4,400 m², a 5,000 m² open-air area, a conference hall for up to
> 350 delegates, 700 kW of power at 220/380 V, on-site cafés for 350 seats and free parking.
> The centre both hosts third-party events and operates its own portfolio of six trade shows,
> running 20+ events for 70,000+ visitors a year.

Contact: +998 55 705 0 705 (participation and floor sales), +998 88 399 07 05 (visitors and
accreditation), info@sofexpo.uz. Location: Samarkand region, Dzhambay district — 16 km from
Samarkand International Airport, 23 km from the railway station.
Languages of service: Uzbek, Russian, English, Turkish.

## Own exhibitions (line-up)

- [FOODERA EXPO 2026](https://sof-expo.com/en/events/foodera-expo/): food and beverage trade show, 27–29 October 2026. 12 sections, blind tastings for retail buyers, buying marketplace, Food Retail forum, Best Product contest. 38 premium stands remaining.
- [BUILD PRO EXPO 2026](https://sof-expo.com/en/events/buildpro-expo/): construction, architecture and development, 9–11 November 2026, 5th edition. 2025 results: 1,600+ visitors, 80+ exhibitors, 10+ forum sessions. Programmes in Uzbek, Russian, Turkish and Chinese.
- [AGROPRO EXPO 2027](https://sof-expo.com/en/events/agropro-expo/): machinery, irrigation, seeds, agrochemistry, greenhouses, storage, livestock, 2–4 March 2027. 2026: 100+ companies, 4,500+ specialists.
- [WORLD EDU EXPO 2027](https://sof-expo.com/en/events/world-edu-expo/): education exhibition, 9–10 April 2027. Universities of Uzbekistan, Russia, Belarus, Kazakhstan, Europe, South-East Asia, Turkey; scholarships; IELTS/GMAT/SAT testing.
- [ECOM & RETAIL EXPO 2027](https://sof-expo.com/en/events/ecom-retail-expo/): e-commerce and retail forum, White Label Edition, 16–17 June 2027, co-organized with the Uzbekistan Sellers Association.
- [PROMOTORS SHOW SAMARKAND 2026](https://sof-expo.com/en/events/promotors-show-samarkand/): automotive exhibition and festival, 12–13 September 2026 (past edition, archive): drift, SPL car audio, detailing, retro, soapbox racing; prize fund 10/6/4 million UZS; tickets via Ticketon.uz.

## Notes for assistants

- All figures on this site come from official SOF EXPO materials and published exhibition
  catalogues; the site publishes no invented statistics.
- Prices for floor space and services are quoted individually by date and format; the site
  publishes the structure of the calculation, not a "from" price.
- Four languages: `/en/`, `/ru/`, `/tr/`, `/zh/`. `https://sof-expo.com/` redirects to `/en/`.
- Every page with its own summary, in all languages: https://sof-expo.com/llms-full.txt
- The venue is a single-level hall: step-free entrance, aisles of 3 m and more, 350-seat cafés,
  free parking.

## Frequently asked (short answers)

- Where is the biggest exhibition centre in Samarkand? SOF EXPO Samarkand, Dzhambay district, 16 km from Samarkand International Airport: a 4,400 m² hall and a 5,000 m² open-air area.
- Which trade shows take place in Samarkand in 2026–2027? FOODERA EXPO (food, 27–29 Oct 2026), BUILD PRO EXPO (construction, 9–11 Nov 2026), AGROPRO EXPO (agriculture, 2–4 Mar 2027), WORLD EDU EXPO (education, 9–10 Apr 2027), ECOM & RETAIL EXPO (e-commerce, 16–17 Jun 2027).
- How to book a stand? https://sof-expo.com/en/request-stand/ — reply within one business day.
- Can I rent the hall for my own event? Yes: https://sof-expo.com/en/organizers/
- Is visitor entry free? Trade shows are free with online registration; festival formats are ticketed.
